is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. and Anopheles funestus (Page 1, Title).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper mentions kdr and metabolic resistance in the background and discussion but does not report genotyping results for any of the target markers (e.g., Vgsc, Ace-1) for the mosquitoes collected in this study.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype counts or frequencies for target resistance markers are provided. The study only reports species identification and bioassay results (Table 1).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from Pitoa, North Cameroon (Page 2, 'Study area and mosquito populations').

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study evaluating bednet efficacy in experimental huts (Page 1).

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted in Pitoa, North Cameroon (Page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from July to October 2004 (Page 2).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Routine experimental hut trial in a known study site (Pitoa).

supplement.evidence: The paper does not indicate that genotype data for target markers is available in supplementary files.

assessment.summary: This study evaluates the efficacy of bifenthrin-impregnated bednets against Anopheles funestus and pyrethroid-resistant Anopheles gambiae in Pitoa, North Cameroon. While the study identifies species within the An. gambiae complex (An. arabiensis and An. gambiae s.s. S-form) and references metabolic resistance, it does not report genotype data for any of the target insecticide resistance markers such as Vgsc or Ace-1.
exclusion_reasons: Does not report genotype data for target insecticide resistance markers (e.g., Vgsc, Ace-1).
